metadata.article_title: Language to be used in representations for redress of grievances

article.title: Language to be used in representations for redress of grievances
article.content: Every person shall be entitled to submit a representation for the redress of any grievance to any officer or authority of the Union or a State in any of the languages used in the Union or in the State, as the case may be.
article.html:
350Language to be used in representations for redress of grievances

Article 350 · Part XVII

Every person shall be entitled to submit a representation for the redress of any grievance to any officer or authority of the Union or a State in any of the languages used in the Union or in the State, as the case may be.
